verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an agent framework and runtime. LangGraph includes managed persistence through checkpointers, stores and the Agent Server's managed database, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no export feature, no open-format data dump and no migration-out path. Being able to back checkpoints with a user's own Postgres database is a storage choice, not an export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
